title: local multiline text projection
reference_scope: Independent native-child matrix/bilinear sampling; C08 uses actual standalone child raster to isolate projection, not independent glyph shaping.
gate: All decoded RGB pixels have maximum absolute channel error <= 5. Controlled raster acceptance, not a general quality benchmark.
